hook: Manganese enzymes hold about 20% of the manganese in Antarctic diatoms.

readout.label: Diatom Mn quota in superoxide dismutases

summary: A large share of the manganese in Southern Ocean diatoms sits inside superoxide dismutase enzymes, and manganese-starved diatoms swap in a nickel version. The team combined protein profiling of wild diatoms, lab cultures and statistical modeling. The wild estimate comes from one Antarctic polynya.
title: Superoxide dismutase shapes manganese stoichiometry in Southern Ocean diatoms.
